SELECT
  SUM(state_data.state_total) as sum_of_state_totals,
  AVG(state_data.invoice_count) as avg_invoices_per_state
FROM (
  SELECT 
    c.State,
    SUM(i.Total) as state_total,
    COUNT(*) as invoice_count
  FROM Invoice i
  JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  WHERE i.InvoiceDate > '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND i.InvoiceDate < '2012-06-26 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY c.State
) as state_data
